 FISCHER – your partner for surface inspection 
Coating thickness measurement, material analysis, and material testing are the core of what we do. Since 1953, we have been driven by a passion for developing innovative measuring technology – empowering you to reliably ensure your quality, sustainably optimize your production processes, and strategically reduce your costs. Rely on high-performance measuring solutions that deliver dependable results for your applications, and on a customer service that supports you in your day-to-day operations.
Coating thickness measurement
Precise measurement of coating thicknesses on metallic and non-metallic substrates.
